newsitem.title: JAMAICA: Jamaica judge removed after jailing rape plaintiff.
newsitem.headline: Jamaica judge removed after jailing rape plaintiff.

text.p: A Jamaican rape trial resumed with a new judge and jury on Thursday after women's groups reacted with horror to the previous judge's decision to jail the plaintiff for mumbling during her testimony.

Supreme Court Justice Basil Reid grew frustrated on Tuesday with the 22-year-old woman's failure to speak clearly when she testified against Austin Lee, the man she said had raped her. As a result, he ordered the woman to spend the night in prison, while sending the defendant home on bail.

Hundreds of members of women's and political groups protested Reid's actions in front of the courthouse in Kingston on Wednesday, prompting Reid's removal from the case. The judge apologised, saying, "It was not intended to impose any punitive measure."

The alleged rape victim had complained she did not feel well before her testimony on Tuesday and then spoke so softly she could not be heard. When she was ordered to prison, she started to cry, saying she had left her child in the custody of relatives in the country and needed to return home.
